tools.name: search_business
tools.description: Find a business BY NAME (plus optionally city/country). Returns matching businesses with a stable id to use with get_profile and ask_business. Example query: 'brasserie van dam amsterdam'. NOTE: this matches business names only. To browse by category ('italian restaurants in amsterdam') use discover

tools.name: discover_businesses
tools.description: Browse businesses by CATEGORY and place. Use when the caller does NOT know a specific business name, e.g. category 'italian restaurant' + city 'amsterdam' + country 'netherlands'. Full profiles (with approved Q&As) rank above basics-only placeholder entries; results carry the same stable id for get_

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Read the full profile of one business: every question and answer with sources and approval status ('owner-approved' answers were confirmed by the verified business owner). Use the business id from search_business.

tools.name: ask_business
tools.description: Ask a free-text question about one business.
